source.note: Aurora, CO facility (formerly Advanced Circuits), 2026 capabilities sheet, Standard column. Values are in inches; outer layers are listed by BASE copper (1/2 oz base plates to about 1 oz finished).

min_track.quote: Outer Layer Trace Width - ½ oz. Cu. Base 0.004
min_track.derived: 0.004 in = 4 mil; 1/2 oz base, about 1 oz finished

min_track.quote: Outer Layer Trace Width - 1 oz. Cu. Base 0.005
min_track.derived: 0.005 in = 5 mil; 1 oz base, about 2 oz finished

min_gap.quote: Outer Layer Space - Trace to Trace - ½ oz. Cu. Base 0.004
Outer Layer Space - Trace to Trace - 1 oz. Cu. Base 0.005

min_drill.quote: Smallest Mechanical PTH - Via (Aspect ratio driven) 0.006 0.004

min_annular_ring.quote: Drill/Pad Size - No Break Out - Thru Drill nominal +.012
min_annular_ring.derived: pad = drill + 0.012 in, so the ring is 0.006 in = 6 mil

min_hole_to_hole.quote: Minimum Hole to Hole Edge for PTH 0.010

min_mask_sliver.quote: Solder Mask Web Width Over Laminate (i.e. between pads) 0.004 0.003

min_silk_width.quote: Minimum Silkscreen Line Width / Height (white only) 0.005 0.003

copper_to_edge.quote: Minimum Copper Spacing to Board Edge 0.010
